detail.longDescription: Watched David Krakauer on StarTalk this weekend. His take: LLMs are capable, not intelligent. What I think they're missing is wisdom - intuition from experience. So I had Claude interview me on whether an agent with memory could grow some. I landed on an adviser that argues with me but never makes the final call. Would you want an AI that pushes back, or one that agrees? https:// latentmirror.com/posts/can-a-h arness-be-wise/ # AI # LLM # AIAgents # Philosophy # Claude
